name: ImgGuard
author: [https://github.com/codedbyjake Jake Linford]
description: Screens uploaded images for explicit content before they're saved.

ImgGuardEnforce.description: Whether flagged uploads are actually rejected. When false, ImgGuard only logs what it would have done.

ImgGuardLogPasses.description: Whether to log the score of every upload that passes, not just flagged or failed ones.

ImgGuardFailClosed.description: Whether uploads are rejected if classification does not complete.

ImgGuardSfwThreshold.description: Minimum SFW probability required for an upload to pass.

ImgGuardModelPath.description: Path to the ONNX model file.

ImgGuardMatureModelPath.description: Path to a second ONNX model. Each view is scored by both models and the lower safe score is kept. Empty disables it.

ImgGuardTimeout.description: Maximum seconds to allow the classification script to run.

ImgGuardMemoryLimit.description: Maximum memory (in KB) the classification script may use. Overrides $wgMaxShellMemory for this script.

ImgGuardThreads.description: CPU threads each classification may use. Multiplied by ImgGuardMaxConcurrent this should stay at or below the host's core count.

ImgGuardMaxConcurrent.description: Maximum classifications allowed to run at once across all web workers. 0 disables the limit.

ImgGuardCacheTtl.description: How long (in seconds) a file's classification verdict is cached.

ImgGuardFailureCacheTtl.description: How long (in seconds) a classification failure is negative-cached.

ImgGuardEligibleMimeTypes.description: Extra MIME types to classify beyond the built-in image/* and video/* match, matched against the sniffed content type. Other uploads pass through unchecked.

ImgGuardBorderlineMargin.description: An upload that passes but scores within this margin above ImgGuardSfwThreshold is logged as imgguard/borderline instead of imgguard/pass.

ImgGuardAutoBlockEnabled.description: Whether a user is automatically blocked after ImgGuardAutoBlockThreshold real (enforced) rejections. Users with imgguard-autoblock-exempt are exempt.

ImgGuardAutoBlockThreshold.description: Number of real (enforced) imgguard/reject log entries, within ImgGuardAutoBlockWindow, that triggers an automatic block.

ImgGuardAutoBlockWindow.description: How far back to count real rejections toward ImgGuardAutoBlockThreshold, as a string accepted by strtotime().

ImgGuardAutoBlockDuration.description: Duration of the automatic block, as a string accepted by strtotime().
